poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE RHYTHM OF THE HEART IS A WILD AND UNSTABLE THING
poetryFrame.rightVertical: A SWEET FANTASY WE CANNOT HELP BUT EMBRACE TONIGHT
poetryFrame.bottomLine: LET THE MOMENT TAKE US, NO TURNING BACK NOW
sonnetLines: The pulse beats out a secret code,
A breathless rhythm in the fading light.
We dance upon the shifting road,
Lost to the magic of the endless night.
Your gaze holds me, electric and deep,
A current pulling where I cannot stray.
Washing away the doubt of yesterday.
The heat rises like a golden haze,
We wander through these beautiful maze,
Reflected truth within your knowing eyes.
Let the control dissolve and drift away,
Just feel the pull until the break of day.
